scope: New accountSecurity and _securityChallenges paths introduced for the Account Security Centre
summary: Both paths are denied to every client, including owners and administrators. Sanitised policy data is returned only by an authenticated, App Check-protected callable, and no challenge secret or hash is returned. The broader existing Firestore rules remain unchanged apart from these default-deny additions.
regressionTests: Unauthenticated clients cannot read or write account security policy documents
Account owners cannot read or write their account security policy documents directly
Administrators cannot bypass the server-owned policy boundary
No client can read or write future security challenge documents
